observations: Photo 0 shows a Toyota engine bay/engine assembly on the ground with hoses and wiring harnesses attached; visible intake/exhaust-side components and a silver engine block.
Photo 1 shows another angle of the same engine assembly with the intake manifold/air intake ducting and more wiring/hoses visible.
Photo 2 shows the engine from the other side with a large plastic engine cover/airbox area and additional attached components; no clear model/engine code plate is readable.

claims.claim: Complete engine with compressor and all the operators for toyota venza,camry, sienna, Hylander,...
claims.evidence: Photos show an engine assembly with attached components, but the presence/condition of an A/C compressor and whether all required “operators”/accessories for those specific models are included is not clearly verifiable from the images (no clear compressor label, no full accessory list, no readable compatibility markings).

risks.risk: A/C compressor may be missing or not included (seller says “with compressor”, but compressor identity/part is not clearly confirmed in the photos).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the A/C compressor unit (front label/part number) and a photo showing it physically mounted/packaged with the engine.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine assembly only (no confirmed compressor), i.e., worst-case for missing A/C compressor.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: Venza/Camry/Sienna/Highlander may use different engine variants (and sometimes different wiring/ECU/hoses). Photos don’t show engine code/variant or ECU/loom details.
risks.proof: Photo of the engine code/ID plate (or stamped engine code) and photos of the ECU and main wiring harness connectors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used engine assembly with unknown exact fitment; treat as requiring matching parts/possible mismatch.

risks.risk: “Complete” risk: may be missing key items (starter, alternator, sensors, belts/harness sections, mounts, cooling hoses, intake parts). Photos don’t confirm completeness.
risks.proof: A laid-out inventory photo/video showing every included component (starter, alternator, alternator bracket, sensors, throttle body, coils, radiator hoses, mounts, etc.).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed complete; assume missing small parts/sensors that affect install.

risks.risk: Condition/working status risk: no proof of running/test; photos only show appearance.
risks.proof: Video of the engine running (cold start if possible) or a compression test / leak-down report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: needs overhaul/unknown condition).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the A/C compressor (label/part number) and confirmation it is included (or mounted).
Photo of the engine code/ID plate (stamped code) and the ECU/wiring harness connectors for exact variant.
A full parts checklist/inventory photo showing what is included (starter, alternator, sensors, mounts, hoses, ECU, harness, etc.).
Video proof: engine start/run or compression test results.
response.reason: The photos show a Toyota engine assembly, but the key pricing drivers—exact engine variant, whether the A/C compressor is included, and whether it’s truly complete and working—are not verifiable remotely from these images.
